up: Return a list of activity records for the assay identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3507681. For each record, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the exact standard value, the standard units, the standard relation, the standard type, and the canonical SMILES structure. Include all records for this assay, regardless of the standard relation or value.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3507681';
